659:t_012:17.en:
$$早乙女$$
(It's simple. Understand others, accept them... and advance into the future together.)

659:t_012:18.en:
$$早乙女$$
(That is the power that lets lives, each tiny and frail alone, endure in this dark, boundless universe... In other words, the truth of life...)

659:t_012:19.en:
$$早乙女$$
(To express that, I built a machine that unites three hearts as one... $$ゲッターロボ$$.)

659:t_012:20.en:
$$コーウェン$$
(I understand...! I understand $$早乙女$$'s words!)

659:t_012:21.en:
$$スティンガー$$
(When we researched $$ゲッター線$$, we shared our dreams, shared our prospects, and shared our future!)

659:t_012:23.en:
$$スティンガー$$
(That is the power to live in the universe!)

659:t_012:25.en:
$$スティンガー$$
(We no longer feel hunger or the urge to destroy...)

659:t_012:28.en:
$$早乙女$$
(Take care, $$元気$$... No, $$渓$$... Don't give up.)

659:t_013:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「So $$ゲッター線$$... Dr. $$早乙女$$'s guidance freed them from the Great Void too.」

659:t_014:2.en:
$$渓$$
「The dimensional boundary is warping around that rift... No, it's collapsing!」

659:t_014:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「The Great Void... the force that seeks to vanish...!」

659:t_014:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is the universe's great collapse happening here?!」

659:t_014:6.en:
$$桂$$
「No! Even if I tried to repair space-time, we don't know anything about the $$超特異点$$!」

659:t_014:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「At this rate, the whole universe will become the Great Void...!」

659:t_014:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Basically, we just have to stop that thing, right?!」

659:t_015:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Wait, $$竜馬$$! Even you can't do this alone!」

659:t_015:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... Sorry for dragging you along.」

659:t_015:5.en:
$$弁慶$$
「We're stuck with each other. Don't worry about it.」

659:t_015:6.en:
$$隼人$$
「So... Do we have a chance of winning?」

659:t_015:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「How the hell should I know?」

659:t_015:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I just fight with everything I've got, every time!」

659:t_016:2.en:
$n
「Can't you do anything, Dr. $$トライア$$?!」

659:t_016:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ゲッターロボ$$, which unites three hearts as one... If we have the power of $$ゲッター線$$ as well, then perhaps...」

659:t_016:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$ゲッター$$! If you want me to do something for you, listen to me for once!」

659:t_016:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That dimensional rift...! Lend me the power to blow away the Great Void! I'll give you my life if that's what it takes!」

659:t_017:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「That isn't the usual light of $$ゲッター線$$!」

659:t_017:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$竜馬$$ and $$ゲッターロボ$$'s... wills are... becoming one...」

659:t_018:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Our absolute coordinates are those of the point where we encountered the $$インベーダー#pilot$$.」

659:t_018:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems the Great Void's space has vanished.」

659:t_018:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Now that it's over, it doesn't matter. Let's think about what's ahead instead.」

659:t_019:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$クォーター$$ reports that both everyone from $c and the Galactic Raid Fleet somehow made it through safely!」

659:t_019:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「The new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 is intact too.」

659:t_019:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Now that the $$インベーダー#pilot$$ have vanished along with the dimensional rift, we'll press straight on to the galactic center.」

659:t_019:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The decisive battle with the $$バアル$$... the $$宇宙怪獣$$, is coming...」

659:t_020:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't think you can stop us just by bringing out more bodies!」

659:t_021:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
(The end of those who drown in power and lose sight of the path to $$シンカ$$... It's sad...)

659:t_022:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「All right! The third target is down!」

659:t_022:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Get ready, $$インベーダー#pilot$$! There's no stopping us now!」

659:t_023:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have confirmed the fourth target is destroyed.」

659:t_023:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you are beings who only take lives, we will fight you to protect them!」

659:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Get ready, $$インベーダー#pilot$$ bosses! Don't think we'll give up just because there are more of you!」

659:t_100:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You brat! Your arrogance ends here!」

659:t_100:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「No one can defeat us in this space of the Great Void!」
